text: Osamu Saitou
{character:Osamu Saitou}I understand. You'll need to think about it carefully given your late grandfather's teachings, right?
Mai Aihara
{character:Mai Aihara}I'm sorry, as far as I know, the Temple of Moons has never held an event like this.
{character:Narration}Under the torii of the Temple of Moons, the evening sun casts shadows of myself, Osamu Saitou, and Mai Aihara.
{character:Mai Aihara}Before he died, grandpa said that the Temple of Moons doesn't need any festivals now. I... don't want to go against the old man's wishes.

{character:Narration}To promote the tourism industry of One Han City, Osamu has recently gotten in touch with all the major temples and shrines to organize a temple festival. Among them, the Temple of Moons is one of Osamu's main investment targets due to its long history, and he has put forward quite favorable conditions.
{character:Narration}He heard that I have a good relationship with Mai, so he hopes that I can help him persuade Mai to agree to this cooperation, but Mai's concerns aren't what I imagined.
player
{character:player}I didn't expect your grandfather to say something like that to you.
{character:Mai Aihara}Yea... I'm sorry, Mr. Saitou, I... I'm not trying to make things difficult for you.
{character:Osamu Saitou}It's okay. Each shrine has its own way of doing things, and you don't need to apologize for that.
{character:Osamu Saitou}But this cooperation is beneficial to the operation of the Temple of Moons. It's beneficial for both sides, so I hope you'll consider it in more detail.
{character:Osamu Saitou}But, I'm a little confused about what you just said, because the Temple of Moons held a festival 15 years ago.
{character:Mai Aihara}Eh?
{character:player}Eh?
{character:Osamu Saitou}I was lucky enough to participate in that festival. Many of the residents around here should still remember the Kagura dance of the Aihara family.
{character:Mai Aihara}The Kagura dance... I think... I have heard people praise it before.
{character:Osamu Saitou}Anyways, please consider it carefully. If you're willing to take part, my company guarantees that this event will be good for the promotion of your shrine and its revenue.

{character:Osamu Saitou}I'll be meeting Kana Fujita, one of the artists my company has signed, in an hour to discuss her appearance at the festival, so I'll be on my way. {var:player_nickname}, thank you for helping me make an appointment to meet Miss Aihara today.
{character:player}Don't mention it. I only introduced you because Mai wanted to meet you. I'll show you out.
{character:Narration}Mai and I walk to the side of the road and watch Osamu get in a car and leave.
{character:Mai Aihara}I'm really sorry! I didn't say yes to this amazing opportunity you gave me.
{character:player}It's okay. Both parties need to reach a consensus to do business together. It's your right to decide the shrine's affairs.
{character:Mai Aihara}But... Actually, I'm not sure whether I should reject it or not. Grandpa's teachings are important, but this is a rare opportunity from a business perspective, right?
{character:Mai Aihara}What do you think? Should I agree to hold a festival at the shrine?
{character:Narration}Mai is torn by this difficult decision. She is a person who gets troubled easily, and she will continue to be troubled by the issue until she has an answer.
{character:player}I think you should do it. More and more people have been coming to pray at the Temple of Moons, so a festival would be very lively.
{character:player}And the old people who come to the activity room were also guessing whether there would be a temple festival this year.
{character:Mai Aihara}Is everyone looking forward to it so much? Hmm... but I'm still a little concerned about what grandpa said.

{character:Mai Aihara}I've only inherited the shrine for a few years... Many operational matters are carried out according to grandpa's will... and everyone at the Mahjong Soul Shrine has been helping me... That's why everything has gone well so far. That's why I don't dare to make such a big decision...
{character:player}It's alright. It's a lot of work to organize a festival, so it can't hurt to be prudent.
{character:Narration}I comfort Mai because she is looking a little depressed. Unexpectedly, her eyebrows relaxed soon, as if she thought of something important.
{character:Mai Aihara}The Mahjong Soul Shrine... That's right, Ichihime and the others might know why grandpa said festivals were unnecessary.
{character:player}Is that so?

{character:Mai Aihara}Yes! The Temple of Moons and Mahjong Soul Shrine have a lot of shared history, and grandpa and everyone from the Mahjong Soul Shrine had known each other for a long time. Maybe he had mentioned something to them.
{character:player}Sure, let's go over and ask about it after dinner.
{character:Narration}Mai and I make plans to go to the Mahjong Soul Shrine together after dinner and ask Wanjirou about the past.
Wanjirou
{character:Wanjirou}As far as I know, the old priest didn't want to organize any festivals because he was afraid of being reminded of his deceased wife, woof.
{character:Wanjirou}Mai's grandma loved festivals. No festivals have been held there since she passed away.
{character:Mai Aihara}So when grandpa said: "the Temple of Moons doesn't need any festivals now," he meant that he didn't want to get emotional at the festival?
Ichihime
{character:Ichihime}Yes, nyaa. Before that, the Temple of Moons always held festivals, and even I took part in them, nyaa!
{character:Mai Aihara}Now that you mention it... I seem to have a little impression of that.
{character:Wanjirou}You should have been around three years old at that time, woof.
{character:player}Three years old? That's exactly 15 years ago. It matches what Osamu said.
{character:Mai Aihara}I see, so grandpa doesn't hate festivals... He just misses grandma too much...
{character:Ichihime}Osamu invited the Mahjong Soul Shrine too, nyaa. Wanjirou already agreed to it, right?
{character:Wanjirou}There will be lots of interesting booths if there's a festival, and we can make a lot of money too!
{character:Mai Aihara}Should we hold a festival together...
{character:Narration}After hearing Ichihime and Wanjirou's words, Mai lowers her head and purses her lips... After a while, she raises her head again.
{character:Mai Aihara}What do you think, Master? I... Part of me wants to organize a festival.

{character:player}I think that if the old priest stopped holding festivals because he was afraid of evoking past memories, then this is the time to start organizing them again. Your grandma would be delighted too if she could see you organizing festivals again.
{character:Wanjirou}I think so too, woof!
{character:Mai Aihara}If the Mahjong Soul Shrine is participating, the Temple of Moons should join too... Yes! I've decided that the Temple of Moons will also organize a festival!
{character:Narration}Mai once said that the two shrines had some shared history. Perhaps that's why she changed her mind.
{character:Ichihime}This is great, nyaa! I'm going to have cotton candy and grilled squid at the festival! And play lots of games, nyaa!
{character:Narration}The Mahjong Soul Shrine is as lively as ever, but perhaps this is the exact kind of carefree atmosphere that can help Mai overcome her worries.
{character:player}Do you know why the old priest didn't want to hold festivals?
{character:Mai Aihara}Eh? No...
{character:player}Based on what I know about Osamu, almost all the events he promotes are a great success. The Temple of Moons should make a lot of profit if it joins in.
{character:player}But I'm worried that the old priest might have a special reason for saying that. I think that knowing his reason will help us make a decision.
{character:Mai Aihara}You're right, but... I don't know why grandpa never organized a festival either.

{character:Mai Aihara}I've only inherited the shrine for a few years... Many operational matters are carried out according to grandpa's will... and everyone at the Mahjong Soul Shrine has been helping me... That's why everything has gone well so far. That's why I don't dare to make such a big decision...
{character:player}Organizing a festival is a big decision, so it can't hurt to be prudent.
{character:Narration}I comfort Mai because she is looking a little depressed. Unexpectedly, her eyebrows relaxed soon, as if she thought of something important.
{character:Mai Aihara}The Mahjong Soul Shrine! That's right, Ichihime and the others might know something.
{character:player}Alright, there's still some time until dinner, so why don't we go and ask them now?
{character:Ichihime}I know! Mai's grandfather doesn't like temple festivals because Mai's grandmother really liked them!

{character:Narration}Mai and I arrive at the Mahjong Soul Shrine and see Ichihime and Kaguyahime sitting together drinking tea. After Mai asks Ichihime about the festival, she finds out that Ichihime really does know the reason, but she isn't the only one who knows...
Kaguyahime

{character:Kaguyahime}Hehe, shorty, do you know you need to take responsibility for the things you say? I think it's because he wanted to protect the go-shintai, the divine artifact worshipped in the shrine. After all, the Temple of Moons' go-shintai is quite special.
{character:Ichihime}Nyaa! You don't understand the old priest at all, you stupid rabbit, nyaa!

{character:Kaguyahime}I don't understand humans, but I understand deities. The old priest is someone who serves deities. How can he do a good job if he doesn't understand what's truly important? Do you think he is like a certain short priestess who just eats and sleeps all day?
{character:Ichihime}Nyaa! You also ate some of those snacks just then!
{character:Narration}I knew it. Whenever Ichihime and Kaguyahime are together, they will start their trademark bickering that no one can cut in.
{character:player}...Where's Wanjirou? He at least might have a chance to persuade these two.
{character:Mai Aihara}Ichihime said Wanjirou just went out and she didn't know when he'll return.
{character:Narration}How troublesome. The only slightly more reliable person in Mahjong Soul Shrine is not around just when we need him.
{character:Ichihime}What do you think, Mai? What I said makes more sense, right?
{character:Kaguyahime}In that case I want to know what you think too. Think carefully before you answer, hehe.
{character:Mai Aihara}Well... Um... Urgh... What should I do, Master? What should I say?
{character:player}I think... Ichihime's version is closer to the truth.
{character:Ichihime}Master, you really are the best master ever, nyaa!

{character:Mai Aihara}Ah... I think I remember something now. When I was little, the shrine was indeed very lively... like there were festivals. However, things have never been that lively ever since grandma passed away...
{character:player}This supports Ichihime's version of events. The old priest wasn't willing to organize festivals by himself after his wife passed away because he missed her.
{character:Kaguyahime}That sounds like it makes sense. However, human, you can't just look at the surface for some things. The Temple of Moons has lots of things for you to explore, hehe.

{character:Narration}When I want to ask her more, Kaguyahime waves her hand and tells me that the secrets of heaven shouldn't be revealed. The Temple of Moons... What other things are... Oh well, I'll always have the chance to find out in the future. It's more important to help Mai solve her problem first.
{character:Ichihime}I can't wait to organize the festival with you, Mai, nyaa!
{character:Mai Aihara}Organize the festival with me? Is Mahjong Soul Shrine also...?

{character:Ichihime}Nyaa! I thought I told you. The Mahjong Soul Shrine also received an invitation from the big boss Osamu, nyaa. Wanjirou has gone outside to negotiate! Let's organize the most magnificent festival together, nyaa!
{character:Mai Aihara}...If the Mahjong Soul Shrine is participating, the Temple of Moons indeed should join too.
{character:Narration}Mai once said that the two shrines had some shared history. Perhaps that's why she is starting to change her mind.
{character:Mai Aihara}What do you think, Master? I... kind of want to organize a festival now.

{character:player}I think that if the old priest stopped holding festivals because he was afraid of seeing things that would remind him of his deceased wife, then this is the time to start organizing them again. Your grandma would be delighted too if she could see you organizing festivals again.
{character:Mai Aihara}Yes... In that case, I've decided to organize a festival with the Mahjong Soul Shrine!
{character:Ichihime}This is great, nyaa! I'm going to have cotton candy and grilled squid at the festival! I'm going to play lots of games at the festival, nyaa!
{character:Narration}The Mahjong Soul Shrine is as noisy as ever, but perhaps this is the exact kind of carefree atmosphere that can help Mai overcome her worries.
{character:Narration} In the next few months, together with Ichihime and Wanjirou, we began to prepare for the festival with Osamu's help.
{character:Narration}It is soon the evening, and it is time for the official opening of the festival jointly organized by the Temple of Moons and Mahjong Soul Shrine.
Kaavi
{character:Kaavi}Here visitor, please draw a lot to divine your fate.
Visitor A
{character:Visitor A} Yay! It's a "great blessing!"
Visitor B
{character:Visitor B}*Sighs* Why did I have to draw a "misfortune!" What should I do?
{character:Kaavi}Unfortunately, fate isn't something that can be changed that easily.
{character:Visitor B}Eh? I can't change my luck?
{character:Kaavi}You can consider hanging it on the sacred tree if you want to put up a meaningless fight against it. Now you can pay the fee here.
{character:Narration}Mai and I are watching over the ema booth. We can see that Kaavi is helping the visitors draw lots.
{character:Mai Aihara}It's been a long time since there have been so many visitors here at the Temple of Moons.
{character:player}Yeah.
{character:Mai Aihara}I... really like this kind of lively atmosphere.
{character:Osamu Saitou}Please give me an ema. Thanks.
{character:Mai Aihara}Y-You're welcome!

{character:Narration}Osamu, who had been extremely busy since three days before the festival, suddenly appears in front of our booth. His assistant isn't accompanying him, so it seems that he is just walking around enjoying the festival instead of working.
{character:Mai Aihara}Um... Thank you for helping us with this festival! H-Here's the ema you wanted!

{character:Osamu Saitou}You're welcome. Miss Aihara, your popularity has played a big role in promoting the festival to make it such a grand occasion. I think it's very rewarding to organize a festival that brings smiles to people's faces.
{character:Narration}Osamu smiles, then he seems to remember something. He looks at us and continues talking in a serious tone.
{character:Osamu Saitou}It's just as lively here today as it was 15 years ago. I'm going to check out other booths now, so I'll leave you to it then.

{character:Narration}Osamu hangs up the ema and turns around to leave. I look at the ema hanging beside me. His hopes for the future are written with strong and powerful strokes, which are very much his style.
{character:Narration}Thinking back on what Osamu said, I'm a bit curious about the festival they keep mentioning.
{character:player}They keep mentioning that festival. It must have been very grand.
{character:Mai Aihara}Actually... It's not like I don't remember anything about it at all, just that I feel like I'm resisting it whenever I recall anything.
{character:player}Eh? Why is that?
{character:Mai Aihara}Because... I will think of my mother.
{character:Narration}The cheerful atmosphere of the festival continues to flow around her, but Mai's expression has become sorrowful.
{character:Narration}I know she was separated from her mother when she was very little. Maybe she is bringing up this topic because she has remembered some painful things about her past.
{character:Mai Aihara}Originally, my mother, should have inherited the Temple of Moons, but... due to some accidents, she left soon after I was born and has almost never come back to see me...
{character:Narration}Mai said that the only time she met her mother after her mother left was at her grandma's funeral.

{character:Narration}When Mai saw her, she thought she was just a woman wearing black business attire. She came to the mourning hall alone to pay her respects. During this time, she kept her head low, didn't speak to anyone around her, and appeared very indifferent.
{character:Mai Aihara}She left in a hurry after the funeral, and I only received letters from her every year for the next ten plus years.
{character:Narration}As Mai told me about her memories, I could feel how helpless she felt. All words of consolation seemed a little empty to me at this time.
{character:Kana Fujita}Hi everyone, I've finally arrived! I'm sorry I'm late, but there were just too many people at the autograph session just now!
{character:Narration}Kana's work requires her to meet her fans at autograph sessions, as well as to shuttle between booths and interact with visitors as a temporary staff member.
{character:player}Kana, you're here. Don't worry about that. Thank you for agreeing to help us with the booth even though you're already so busy.
{character:Kana Fujita}Hehe, although this is my work, I feel like I'm bursting with motivation after hearing you thank me, {var:player_nickname}!
{character:Kana Fujita}But... I can feel the heavy atmosphere here. This atmosphere is a disaster for an idol! {var:player_nickname}, did you bully Mai?
{character:player}We were talking about some serious topics, but we feel better now that you've arrived, Kana. Isn't that right?
{character:Mai Aihara}Y-Yes... Master is always gentle to me...
Fan A
{character:Fan A}Hey, isn't that Kana? Kana has come to the festival!
Fan B
{character:Fan B}Oh my! Kana, please give me an autograph!
{character:Kana Fujita}Ah... I guess that's the end of my break. Mai, you need to perform the Kagura dance later, so leave this ema booth to me!
{character:Narration}The Kagura dance is an important part of this festival. I've been looking forward to it since the festival started.
{character:Kana Fujita}Go and have some fun while you still have time. I checked out quite a few booths this afternoon and had so much fun!
{character:Narration}Kana then starts working. With an idol promoting the booth, people waiting in line to buy ema doubled in an instant... Such terrifying charisma... I concede defeat.
{character:Mai Aihara}M-Master... Where should we go?
{character:player}Ah, let's forget all that complex stuff and enjoy ourselves thoroughly at the festival! What do you want to play?
{character:Mai Aihara}I... want to play the things you want to play. Please introduce them to me.
{character:Narration}Mai and I come to a booth with lantern riddles.
{character:player}Hi, we want to guess some lantern riddles.
{character:Nanaha Onodera}... Sure, help yourself.
{character:Narration}Nanaha Onodera is busy reading and doesn't bother to look our way.
{character:player}...Um, Nanaha, aren't you in charge of this lantern riddle booth?
{character:Nanaha Onodera}Welcome. Please select any lantern.
{character:Narration}...It looks like she has no intention to look up at the customers at all. Forget it, it's not like this is the first time I've met her. You just have to get used to it.
{character:Narration}So, I let Mai choose a lantern. She took a look at them and then takes a lantern with the character for "tea" on it.

{character:Nanaha Onodera}The first riddle is: "There is a pot at the mouth of the well and a pot at the bottom of the well. In the middle are a handful of mung beans and flowers blooming in the water."
{character:Nanaha Onodera}The clue is the character on the lantern.
{character:Mai Aihara}The character on the lantern is "tea." Does this mean the answer is related to tea?
{character:Nanaha Onodera}Yes. If you can't think of anything, you can ask for more clues.
{character:Mai Aihara}I... think I know the answer.
{character:player}Eh? Already?
{character:Nanaha Onodera}The less time you need to guess the answer, the greater the rewards. So, can you tell me your answer?
{character:Mai Aihara}Um, it should be "a lidded tea bowl," right?
{character:Nanaha Onodera}Correct... You've solved this riddle faster than everyone else so far.
{character:player}That's amazing! Mai, you're so good at guessing riddles.
{character:Mai Aihara}N-Not really... I just know a little more about tea. Grandpa taught me how to make tea with a lidded tea bowl, so I thought of it immediately.
{character:Nanaha Onodera}Choosing a topic you're good at is also a secret of success. Let's move on to the second riddle.
{character:Narration}After we answered all ten riddles, we went to the prize-giving area to choose our prizes.
{character:Mai Aihara}Master, what should we choose?
{character:player}How about that round fan? I think it suits you.
{character:Mai Aihara}Eh? The r-round fan?
{character:player}You contributed the most when we were guessing the answers to the riddles, so it'll be a gift for you.
{character:Mai Aihara}B-But...
{character:player}You don't like it? Then you can choose something else.
{character:Mai Aihara}No, it's not that! I'll take it! I... I'll take this fan.
{character:Narration}After saying that, Mai claims the fan. This is strange... Judging from her reaction, does she like it or not?
{character:Nanaha Onodera}This is a hehuan fan... According to traditional customs, this is usually given to others as a token of love.
{character:Nanaha Onodera}Mai loves reading romance stories, so she must know what it means.
{character:Mai Aihara}Master, thank you for this gift. I... love it.
{character:Narration}Mai returns with the fan, and I see the blessing "Together Forever" written on it. I... I seem to have accidentally made a bold decision.
{character:Narration}Mai and I come to a ring toss booth to play.
{character:Mai Aihara}Go!
{character:Narration}Like a leaf that is falling to the ground in autumn, the bamboo ring flies irregularly through the air and lands crookedly on the ground without capturing any prizes.
{character:Narration}We try several times without any success. Just when we are about to give up...
{character:Sora Ichinose}Try to make the bamboo ring rotate faster.
{character:Mai Aihara}Is that you, Sora? You're also here at the festival?
{character:Sora Ichinose}My body is in good condition today, so my sister agreed to let me come out and have some fun.
{character:Narration}Sora Ichinose is a regular visitor of the Temple of Moons and is quite familiar with Mai. He seems to have seen us toss the bamboo rings when he was passing by.
{character:player}Sora, you know how to toss the rings?
{character:player}That's okay. Let's give it a try, Mai.
{character:Mai Aihara}Yes!
{character:Narration}Mai is aiming for a plushie that looks like Tubby. She tosses the bamboo ring according to Sora's advice.
{character:player}Oh! It seems a lot more stable now. It isn't flying everywhere like before.

{character:Narration}The bamboo ring flies in an arc, spinning in the air, towards the prizes in the back row, but it doesn't capture any prizes, probably because it has deviated slightly from its path.
{character:Mai Aihara}...I still couldn't win anything. It was so close.
{character:Sora Ichinose}I'm sorry... Theory and practice are different after all. I will need to keep learning.
{character:player}It's okay. If we keep trying our best like this, maybe we'll be able to win something later!
Booth Owner
{character:Booth Owner}Here are the prizes you won.
{character:Narration}After about 15 minutes, I finally manage to win a prize, a traditional round fan, using the method Sora taught us.
{character:player}It's a shame I couldn't win the Tubby plushie you really wanted.
{character:Mai Aihara}That's alright. I think this fan looks really nice too.
{character:player}Well... I'll give it to you then, Mai. It suits you better than me anyway.
{character:player}Don't you like it?

{character:Narration}She takes the fan as she speaks. This is strange... Judging from her reaction, does she like it or not? While I'm wondering about this, Sora gives me a quiet reminder from beside me...
{character:Sora Ichinose}{var:player_nickname}, the trademark of this fan says it is a hehuan fan. Maybe her reaction is related to this?
{character:Narration}I suddenly remember that hehuan fans are usually given as a token of love according to traditional customs. Mai loves reading romance stories, so she must know what it means.
{character:Narration}Mai returns with the fan, and I see the blessing "Together Forever" written on it. I... I seem to have done something bold by accident...
{character:Narration}Mai and I come to a booth with balloons and BB guns.
{character:A-37}Welcome!
{character:player}...Is that a BB gun?
{character:A-37}...Do you want to try to shoot the balloons? The more balloons you burst, the more prize options you have.
{character:player}Mai, do you want to try it?
{character:Mai Aihara}But... I've never done this before...
{character:player}Don't worry, it's your first time, so don't worry too much about whether or not you'll hit anything.
{character:Mai Aihara}In that case... I'm going to shoot!
{character:Narration}As I look at her serious expression, I start to worry that she would miss every shot and start to blame myself.
{character:A-37}All ten shots hit the target.
{character:player}M-Mai... you're so amazing!
{character:Mai Aihara}Um... The balloons are really close, and the gun isn't heavy. I practice archery when I train, and that feels much harder than this.
{character:player}Oh, so you learned this from your priestess training. No wonder.
{character:A-37}Based on the results, you indeed have quite the talent for using firearms.
{character:Mai Aihara}T-Talent?
{character:A-37}If you want, I can introduce you to some shooting ranges that use real bullets.
{character:Mai Aihara}R-Real bullets? No thanks. I don't know why I need to learn that.
{character:Narration}Mai and I go to the prize-giving area after shooting the balloons.
{character:Mai Aihara}Master, which prize should I choose?
{character:Mai Aihara}A r-round fan?
{character:player}You got more points when shooting the balloons, so we should choose something suitable for you as a gift.
{character:Mai Aihara}Umm... But...
{character:player}You don't like it? Then you can choose something else.
{character:Narration}Mai claims the fan after speaking. This is strange... Judging from her reaction, does she like it or not?
{character:A-37}According to the prize list, this fan is called a hehuan fan.
{character:Narration}I remember that hehuan fans are usually given as a token of love according to traditional customs. Mai loves reading romance stories, so she must know what it means.
{character:Narration}After that, I continue to wander around everywhere with Mai.
Broadcast
{character:Broadcast}Hello everyone! The Kagura dance performance will be starting in 30 minutes at the square of the Temple of Moons. Please come and watch!
{character:Mai Aihara}Ah... I need to go backstage to prepare. Master, thank you for showing me around and having fun with me.
{character:player}You don't have to thank me. I enjoyed myself too.
{character:Mai Aihara}To thank you... Master, I hope you'll come to watch the Kagura dance.
{character:player}Of course! How can I miss out on your performance? I'll be there.
{character:Mai Aihara}Thank you! Well... I'm going to the dressing room to prepare.
{character:Narration}After that, I continue to wander around the festival and only prepare to go to the square when the Kagura dance is about to start.
{character:player}Ugh!
Little Girl
{character:Little Girl}... Sorry.
{character:Narration}Rushing to the stage, I end up bumping into a little girl around four to five years old.
{character:player}Are you okay?
{character:Narration}I help her up, only to realize that nobody is chaperoning this little girl.
{character:player}Where are your parents?
{character:Little Girl}...
{character:Mai Aihara}...
{character:Narration}The little girl looks quite depressed and doesn't seem to want to talk to me.
{character:Little Girl}Mommy is missing.
{character:player}Missing? Are you lost? Hmm... Where did you get separated?
{character:Little Girl}I don't know.
{character:Narration}I bring the little girl to the broadcasting room next to the torii and broadcast the girl's name a few times.
{character:player}Tell me if you see your mother arrive.
{character:Little Girl}Okay.
{character:Narration}The little girl's mother should come to find her once she hears about the lost girl. However, I didn't see anyone coming after waiting with the little girl for a while.
Passerby A
{character:Passerby A}Quickly! The event's about to start at the square!
Passerby B
